reversal: Immediate reversal changes orientation but preserves the same axis and remains straight.

theorem.continuation: After a nonempty straight history on axis A, the next transfer preserves straightness iff its AXIS equals A; either orientation on A is admissible.
theorem.proof: If all transfers lie in A_{ij}, every vector is ±t and the span is Z*t. Conversely, rank one makes every pair linearly dependent; the primitive-vector theorem forces every transfer to be ± the first transfer, hence to use its unordered axis.
theorem.rank_one_iff: A nonempty D12 history has rank-one integer span iff there exists one unordered pair {i,j} such that every realized transfer lies in A_{ij}.
